mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where a.eta_date >= #{from} and a.eta_date < #{today}) as late_cnt, count(*) filter (where a.eta_date < #{from}) as older_cnt, count(*) filter (where a.eta_date = #{today}) as today_cnt from srm_asn a where a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and a.open_line_cnt > 0 and a.eta_date <= #{today}

select a.asn_no, c.cust_nm, a.plant_cd, a.eta_date, a.open_line_cnt from srm_asn a join mst_cust c on c.cust_id = a.cust_id where a.status in ('SENT', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED') and a.open_line_cnt > 0 and a.eta_date < #{today} order by a.eta_date, a.asn_no limit #{limit}
